label: Rigidity of concrete GOD_4 presence from the standpoint
term: concrete GOD_4 presence is rigid from the standpoint
definition: GodPresenceRigidAt σ m w: for every world v accessible from w and all x, y, if x is a concrete GOD_4 existing at w and y is a concrete GOD_4 existing at v, then y = x. It asserts no existence. Uniqueness consequence: given reflexivity at w, at most one concrete GOD_4 exists at w (atMostOne_of_rigid), and if one exists there, every concrete GOD_4 at an accessible world is that same individual, a cross-world uniqueness commitment. Given reflexivity at w it is weaker than pairwise identity across all worlds accessible from w; without reflexivity the two are incomparable (w not seeing itself, x only at w and y only at an accessible v satisfy pairwise identity and violate rigidity).
note: The stronger sibling of the route's bridge GodPresencePersistsAt: rigidity entails persistence (persists_of_rigid, registered as a strength order) and the fixedPlusVisitor control shows the converse fails. The route does not use rigidity; its uniqueness content would need classical theism's uniqueness of God applied across worlds, which is not recorded here. Open; analyst formulation, attribution deferred.
